name: Human
description: Standard human from the far domains and outer reaches. No special biology — adaptable and found across the galaxy. Background and homeworld define them.

traits.name: Adaptable Baseline
traits.description: No exotic physiology, no biological specialisations. Humans can qualify for every career, wear every suit of armor off the rack, and eat most things that aren't actively trying to eat them back. Flavor only — no mechanical effect.

traits.name: Cultural Variety
traits.description: Your specific human culture is set by your homeworld and background. Feel free to flavor your character's manners, name, and accent accordingly — but by Core rules it grants no additional DMs.
